question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to be updated to extend its useful life in relation to upgradability?
data_point: ability of the product to be updated to extend its useful life
description: The ability of the product to be updated to extend its useful life in relation to upgradability refers to the capability of the product to receive updates or upgrades that enhance its functionality, performance, or features over time. This ensures that the product remains relevant and usable for a longer period, thereby extending its overall lifespan and usefulness to the users.
